title: Whispering Whelk Wizard
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail in a moss-green tank lit like late afternoon, who slowly draws glowing constellations in the sand with one patient tentacle, then hums them awake in soft bubbles. Among sunken teacups, a crooked driftwood tower, and drifting motes of light, he is in no hurry, and neither are the stars.
